[SWS_DM_01394] Support of
SOVD
method
Query for executions of an
operation
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04260, RS_Diag_04258
⌈
For each SOVD operation supporting
asynchronous_execution
, the
Diagnos-
tic Server instance
shall support the SOVD method
Query for executions
of an operation
according to ASAM SOVD[5][14].
⌋
